g.text: Periodic GFN2- x TB in CP2K: Multipolar Ewald Electrostatics, k-Point Sampling, and Transferability
Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation · 2026-09-08
cites: "DFTB+, a software package for efficient approximate density functional theory based atomistic
Periodic implementation of GFN2-xTB in CP2K with a multipolar Ewald treatment of self-consistent shell
charges/dipoles/quadrupoles, analytic stress and forces for cell optimization and MD. Cuts ice-polymorph MAE from
8.0 to 3.5 kJ/mol vs GFN1-xTB on DMC-ICE13; cites your DFTB+ paper.
A First-Principles Multiscale Framework for Topological Superconductivity
Unified multiscale pipeline combining DFT, Wannier low-energy Hamiltonians, Bogoliubov-de Gennes theory and
Matsubara-Green's-function Chern numbers to predict topological superconductivity in FeTeSe and FeSe/GaAs
heterostructures, backed by experimental growth of the latter.

Haozhi Han, Fusong Ju, Jing Bai +8 · arXiv (cs.DC) · 2026-09-01
MakoXC rearchitects linear-scaling DFT exchange-correlation evaluation into GPU-friendly matrix-aligned

Accelerating Atom Simulations with Variable-Block Sparse Matrix Library
VBCSR is a distributed variable-block sparse matrix library that preserves atom-dependent block shapes for
localized-orbital quantum operators, outperforming scalar-sparse reference codes and demonstrated on a >10^6-atom
